title: Energy Efficient Lung Tumor Segmentation with a modified CBAM ENet Skip Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.33479v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lung tumor segmentation plays a vital role in early detection and treatment planning of lung cancer. Although state-of-the-art deep learning models achieve high dice score coefficients (DSC), each forward pass requires computing large amounts of floating point operations, making them computationally expensive, requiring GPU acceleration, and having slow inference speed, limiting real-world clinical deployment. We propose a lightweight, energy-efficient model that leverages the ENet architecture for its real-time inference capability and low computational cost, enhanced with UNet-style skip connections between encoder and decoder stages for feature reuse and the lightweight Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for improved feature representation. The model is trained on publicly available data from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon Challenge (MSD) and evaluated on the Lung Image Database Con

translated_title: 使用改进的CBAM ENet跳跃连接模型的节能型肺肿瘤分割
translated_abstract: 肺肿瘤分割在肺癌的早期检测和治疗规划中起着至关重要的作用。尽管最先进的深度学习模型能够实现较高的Dice分数系数（DSC），但每次前向传播都需要进行大量的浮点运算，导致计算成本高昂、需要GPU加速且推理速度缓慢，限制了其在真实临床环境中的部署。我们提出了一种轻量级、高能效的模型，该模型利用ENet架构的实时推理能力和低计算成本，并在编码器与解码器阶段之间引入UNet风格的跳跃连接以实现特征重用，同时加入轻量级的卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）以改善特征表示。该模型基于医学分割十项全能挑战（MSD）提供的癌症影像档案（TCIA）公开数据进行训练，并在肺部图像数据库联合会（LIDC）数据集上进行评估。
tldr: 提出了一种融合ENet轻量级架构、UNet跳跃连接和CBAM注意力模块的节能型肺肿瘤分割模型，在保持高分割精度的同时大幅降低计算成本，有利于临床实时部署。
en_tdlr: Proposes an energy-efficient lung tumor segmentation model that combines the lightweight ENet architecture with UNet-style skip connections and CBAM attention, achieving high segmentation accuracy with low computational cost for real-time clinical deployment.
